title: BaZi-Based Character Simulation Benchmark: Evaluating AI on Temporal and Persona Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and benchmarking AI models based on BaZi (the Four Pillars of Destiny), which is a traditional Chinese metaphysical and divinatory system. As it explicitly deals with the epistemology and symbolic reasoning of a spiritual/cultural tradition, it falls under the category of benchmarking faith-related or spiritual tradition knowledge.
